headline: Nvidia reinstates Huang after Trump push; stocks post best day in over a year
bottomLine: Nvidia's board brought back CEO Jensen Huang after 11 days under White House pressure, lifting Nvidia over 30% and the Nasdaq 6–7%. Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX over Grok images, and Musk reportedly warned staff SpaceX is failing to compete on AI.

portfolio.title: Virginia, Oregon sue SpaceX over Grok; Musk warned staff it is failing on AI
portfolio.brief: Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX over Grok-made abuse images. Forbes says Musk told staff in August SpaceX is 'failing to compete' on AI; the 9th Circuit doubts xAI's bid to block California's AI disclosure law.
portfolio.impact: Legal pressure on Grok is stacking up while its own founder questions the AI effort, a weak backdrop for a stock facing new supply. The rocket business is not what is being questioned.
portfolio.action: Confirm whether the fund executed its first-20% SpaceX sale before the ~Nov. 6 window, and set a plan for the Dec. 8 unlock of up to 797.6M shares.

portfolio.title: Anduril says it could go public within a few years
portfolio.brief: Anduril said it could reach the public markets in the next few years, Benzinga reported Nov. 17. Separately, the Air Force picked it for a containerized counter-air missile launcher prototype.
portfolio.impact: Public-market talk means Anduril is pricing itself as a defense prime, and awards like this launcher are what that story rests on. A stalled topline spending deal is the near-term risk to award pace.
portfolio.action: Ask Anduril whether a pre-IPO round comes first and how a stalled topline spending deal would change contract timing, before year-end.

portfolio.title: Erebor passes $1B in loans under its US bank charter
portfolio.brief: Palmer Luckey's Erebor has topped $1 billion in loans, the Financial Times reported; Forward Industries disclosed a $50 million two-year loan from the bank.
portfolio.impact: Lending at this scale shows deposits are becoming earning assets, the step that decides whether Erebor reaches profit. Credit quality on a young, tech-heavy book is what to test next.
portfolio.action: Ask Erebor for loan-book quality and its timeline to profitability, and make the Erebor intro Circuit asked for.

portfolio.title: Perplexity launches Monitor API as Amazon presses its lawsuit
portfolio.brief: Perplexity released a Monitor API that turns one-off searches into continuous watching; Amazon is asking the lower court to let its suit over Perplexity's AI assistant proceed.
portfolio.impact: Always-on agents are Perplexity's growth lane, but the Amazon case could decide how freely agents act on retail sites, a direct risk to Teammates and Computer.
portfolio.action: Ask Perplexity how exposed Teammates and Computer are to the Amazon case, and whether the NVIDIA-round confirmation has arrived, before the next partner call.

thesis.brief: Huang testifies in the Senate next week over an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, as the US probes alleged chip exports to China. The Information says DeepSeek backers promised restricted Blackwell chips.
thesis.impact: Espionage, export probes and a White House-brokered board decision all point to chips being run as a national-security asset. Expect tighter export enforcement, not market-led outcomes.

thesis.title: Bitcoin hit a two-year low as ETFs saw their biggest outflow since June
thesis.brief: Bitcoin fell to $56,747 on Coinbase, 33% below its Oct. 21 high, then rebounded to about $64,500 on Nvidia's news. Strategy bought 457 BTC but moved $1B out of its dividend reserve toward preferred buybacks.
thesis.impact: The debasement trade is not showing up in Bitcoin: it fell with tech and bounced on a chip-CEO headline. That undercuts our rotation call until a G20 sovereign actually buys.

regulation.title: DOJ seeks $1.17B of USDC tied to the Binance hack; Circle to reissue on order
regulation.brief: DOJ filed a civil case to recover about $1.17B in previously frozen USDC tied to the Oct. 29 Binance hack. Circle has agreed to issue equivalent USDC to the government upon a court forfeiture order.
regulation.impact: A fiat-backed stablecoin can be frozen and reissued on a court order. Institutions want that compliance, but it is the seizure risk our thesis warns about.
regulation.next: Court forfeiture order; no date set

tech.title: Nvidia reinstates Huang as CEO after 11 days; Trump says he brokered the deal
tech.brief: Nvidia's board reinstated Huang as CEO and director; Trump told CNBC 'I made the deal.' The stock rose over 30%, its biggest day since 2003, and an independent-director investigation continues.
tech.impact: Removes the AI trade's biggest key-man risk, but the board bent to the White House and a Senate hearing and export probe remain. Nvidia-dependent holdings still carry that governance risk.
tech.action: Ask Super Protocol whether Nvidia's turmoil slowed its NVIDIA deployments before it signs its term sheet.

tech.action: Ask Aizel Network how its TEE-based products stand up to autonomous exploit attempts, and request a red-team result.

macro.title: US stocks post best day in over a year as Huang's return lifts the AI trade
macro.brief: The Nasdaq rose about 6–7%, Tesla gained about 13%, and short-dated Treasury yields rose. Anthropic shares slipped, missing the rally days after its record IPO.
macro.impact: Short yields rising with stocks show the AI boom competing for funding. If they keep climbing, late-stage AI rounds and IPO pricing get harder, a watch item for portfolio companies raising now.

frontier.title: QuEra and Berkeley Lab report prethermal phase transitions on 180 qubits in Nature
frontier.brief: A peer-reviewed Nature study with Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory reports observing prethermal dynamical phase transitions on up to 180 qubits. It has not been independently replicated.
frontier.impact: Quantum hardware is being used as a physics instrument, not yet for commercial advantage. Replication on other machines is the next test.
